description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git format-patch' command options and behaviors, including numbered patches, cover letters, and various configurations. It sets up a repository, creates commits, and runs assertions to verify output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label, executing the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test suite.

methods.name: test_num_no_numbered
methods.description: Verifies the number of patches without numbering in the file.

methods.name: test_single_no_numbered
methods.description: Checks that a single patch does not have numbering.

methods.name: test_no_numbered
methods.description: Verifies that multiple patches are without numbering.

methods.name: test_single_cover_letter_numbered
methods.description: Verifies that a patch with a cover letter is numbered correctly.

methods.name: test_single_numbered
methods.description: Checks that a single patch is numbered.

methods.name: test_numbered
methods.description: Verifies multiple patches are numbered correctly.
